post.description: Add an array of time batch entries

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

items[].callerMetadata.description: Use this value to add any properties you may need to reference in case of success and or error.

items[].data.TypeDetails.Type.description: Based on the Type chosen - additional details can be specified by adding them as custom fields.

postCacheChanges.description: Set true to post cache updates as part of action processing. False if omitted.

items[].description: One to 1000 timebatch entry objects. Each item should include the Vista timebatch entry `data` and optional `callerMetadata`

items[].data.Mth.description:
Key to pr/time_batches(Co, Mth, BatchId).

Format `YYYY-MM-01`

items[].data.PostDate.description:
Date you are entering time for.

Format: `YYYY-MM-DD`

items[].data.TypeDetails.description:
Provide the object based on the entry type.

Options for $.TypeDetails.Type: `J-Job`, `M-Mechanic`, `S-SM Work Order`.

items[].data.PaySeq.description: ( Optional ) If omitted, the first Pay Sequence setup for the Pay Period associated to this batch.

items[].data.PRDept.description:
( Optional ) Key to pr/departments(PRCo, PRDept).
If omitted, it will be defaulted based on Vista defaulting logic.

items[].data.InsState.description: Key to pr/states(PRCo, State). Key to pr/insurance_codes(PRCo, InsState, InsCode). Optional. If omitted, will be defaulted based on Vista defaulting logic. Provide null if you want to override the defaulting behavior with no value.

items[].data.LocalCode.description:
( Optional ) Key to pr/locals(PRCo, LocalCode).

If omitted, will be defaulted based on Vista defaulting logic.
Provide `null` if you want to override the defaulting behavior with no value.

items[].data.UnempState.description:
( Optional ) Key to pr/states(PRCo, State).

If omitted, will be defaulted based on Vista defaulting logic.

items[].data.InsCode.description: Key to pr/insurance_codes(PRCo, InsState, InsCode). Optional. If omitted, will be defaulted based on Vista defaulting logic. Provide null if you want to override the defaulting behavior with no value.

items[].data.Cert.description:
( Optional ) Should Earnings appear on Certified PR Reports.

If omitted, N will be defaulted.

items[].data.Craft.description: Key to pr/crafts(PRCo, Craft). Key to pr/classes(PRCo, Craft, Class). Optional. If omitted, will be defaulted based on Vista defaulting logic. Provide null if you want to override the defaulting behavior with no value.

items[].data.Class.description: Key to pr/classes(PRCo, Craft, Class). Optional. If omitted, will be defaulted based on Vista defaulting logic. Provide null if you want to override the defaulting behavior with no value.

items[].data.StartTime.description: Format 24H:mm (13:24). Optional. If omitted, empty string will be defaulted. This value will only be stored if the StartTime and StopTime are provided. The Hours property will override any calculation based on StartTime, StopTime, and BreakHours.

items[].data.StopTime.description: Format 24H:mm (13:24). Optional. If omitted, empty string will be defaulted. This value will only be stored if the StartTime and StopTime are provided. The Hours property will override any calculation based on StartTime, StopTime, and BreakHours.

items[].data.BreakHours.description: Optional. If omitted, 0 will be defaulted. This value will only be stored if the StartTime and StopTime have also been provided. The Hours property will override any calculation based on StartTime, StopTime, and BreakHours.

items[].data.EarnCode.description: Key to pr/earn_codes(PRCo, EarnCode). Optional. If omitted, will be defaulted based on Vista defaulting logic.

items[].data.Memo.description: ( Optional ) If omitted, null will be defaulted.

items[].data.Shift.description: ( Optional ) If omitted, will be defaulted based on Vista defaulting logic.

items[].data.Rate.description: ( Optional ) If omitted, will be defaulted based on Vista defaulting logic.

items[].data.Amt.description: ( Optional ) Amount. If omitted, it will be defaulted based on Vista defaulting logic.

items[].data.CrewTemplateID.description: ( Optional ) Crew Template ID related to the Vista Web Portal. If omitted, null will be defaulted.

items[].data.__custom_fields.description: Add a property for each user defined values that should be set on the header form as part of this action.

items[].data.__disable_validation.description: Disable Vista validations for properties listed in this field.

Customer.description: Key to `ar/customer(CustGroup, Customer)`. `CustGroup` is defaulted based on the provided `SMCo`. Customer must already exist in the `ar/customers` endpoint.

active.description:
Optional.
If omitted, `Y` will be defaulted.

nonBillable.description:
Optional.

If omitted, `N` will be defaulted.

rateTemplate.description:
Key to SM Rate Template. Optional. 

If omitted, null will be defaulted.

billToARCustomer.description:
Alternate Bill To Customer. Optional. Set the Alternate AR Customer to bill to for this SM Customer.

If omitted, null will be defaulted.

CustomerPOSetting.description:
Optional. If omitted, `N` will be defaulted.

Allowed:
- `R` - Required
- `N` - Not Required

PrimaryTechnician.description:
Key to SM Technician. Optional.

If omitted, null will be defaulted.

reviewer.description:
Key to `hq/reviewers(Reviewer)`. Optional.

If omitted, null will be defaulted.

InvoiceGrouping.description:
Optional.

Allowed:
- `C`-One per Customer,
- `S`-One per service site
- `W`-One per work order
- `P`-One per work order scope.

If omitted, `C` will be defaulted.

InvoiceGroupingPOOverride.description: Optional. If omitted, `N` will be defaulted.

invoiceSummaryLevel.description:
Optional. If omitted, `T-Transaction` will be defaulted.

Options:
- `L-Line Type`
- `C-Cost Type`
- `T-Transaction`

DeliveryTo.description:
Invoice Delivery Address Type.

Options:
- `A` AR Customer
- `S` Service Site
- `O` Other


`S` Service Site can only be provided if the `InvoiceGrouping` != `C`

If omitted, null will be defaulted.

Can only be provided if `DeliveryTo` = 'O'.
If provided when `DeliveryTo` is not 'O' the input will be ignored.
